package: @astryxdesign/core

# TableHeaderCell

<th> wrapper that reads TableContext to apply density padding, semibold weight, secondary text color, and divider borders when used inside Table.

**Import:** `import {TableHeaderCell} from '@astryxdesign/core/Table';`

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `children` | `ReactNode` | - | Header cell content. |
